moves.run.desc: You never stop running. Plan your moves so you don't have to stop.
moves.landing.desc: Press DOWN on the way down. Land properly when jumping down from a height so you don't stumble.
moves.ladder.desc: To start climbing up, press UP once while hanging on a ladder.
moves.slide.desc: To start sliding down, press DOWN once while hanging on a ladder.
moves.wallJump.desc: Jump at a wall and press BACK just before touching it. Doing several wall jumps between two walls is a technique known as "tic-tac". Use tic-tac to get through narrow alleys.
moves.wallRun.desc: Jump at a wall and press UP 1–3 times just before touching it. This lets you climb tall objects. Combine it with wall jumps and tic-tac to reach hard-to-get places.
moves.ledge.desc: Press UP while hanging on a ledge.
moves.roll.desc: Press DOWN while running. You can get under low objects with a roll.
moves.frontFlip.desc: Jump and press FORWARD to do a front flip. A front flip is quick and earns points. Several flips in one jump earn more points.
moves.backFlip.desc: Jump and press BACK to do a back flip. A back flip is slower but earns more points than a front flip. Several flips in one jump earn more points. Don't try this trick on flat ground unless you are fast enough.
moves.tigerJump.desc: Press FORWARD while running. It earns points and helps you jump further. Overtake rivals with tiger jumps and use them to perform several advanced tricks.
moves.wallFlip.desc: Press FORWARD just before touching a wall while in the air. A wall flip earns lots of points, but it is really dangerous.
moves.monkeyVault.desc: Jump and press UP over a low obstacle. A monkey vault earns lots of points, but it is a difficult trick.
moves.dash.desc: Press DOWN just before an edge to speed up. Dashes earn points.
moves.monkeyFlip.desc: Do a tiger jump just before a low obstacle and press DOWN above it. A monkey flip is a fast way over low objects and earns quite a few points.
moves.spiderJump.desc: Do a tiger jump just before a low obstacle and press UP above it. A spider jump is a fast way over low objects and earns quite a few points.
moves.poleSlide.desc: To grab a pole and slide down, press DOWN just before touching it while in the air.
moves.poleJump.desc: Jump and press FORWARD before touching a pole or while sliding down it.
moves.poleSpin.desc: To change direction quickly, jump and press BACK before touching a pole or while sliding down it.
